top_signals.summary: European shares snapped two days of losses as oil prices eased and banks gained ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision later Wednesday.

top_signals.title: Romania Set to Curb €10 Billion Foreign Debt Sale Plan This Year
top_signals.summary: Romania’s officials in charge of debt management told investors the country will likely scale back its eurobond issuance plan for this year as it boosted borrowing on the domestic market, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Tata Sons IPO Order Backs Reclusive Tycoon’s Long-Running Ask
top_signals.summary: The Indian central bank’s refusal to relax listing rules for Tata Group’s holding company delivered an outcome long sought by the conglomerate’s biggest minority shareholder, though the road to going public is far from smooth.
